tools.name: search
tools.description: Search every past agent session (all projects and harnesses) for passages about something. Words and meaning both count: exact terms like error text, file names or ids match literally, and a description in other words still finds the passage. Returns the best passages with their session id, project, date and turn number, each followed by a ready-to-copy read(...) call to see the surrounding turns. Results are ranked by relevance, not date: to get the latest word on something, add since= or compare dates. Nothing is hidden: if the hits miss, rephrase in the words the hits use, add project=, or raise k.

query.description: What you are looking for, in words or exact strings.

k.description: Number of passages to return (default 8, max 30).

project.description: Only sessions whose working directory contains this text, e.g. 'crush-thoughts'.

since.description: Only passages at or after this ISO date/time, e.g. 2026-11-02.

until.description: Only passages at or before this ISO date/time.

session.description: Search inside one session only (id or 8+ char prefix).

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read a past session's turns verbatim (user, assistant and tool turns, tool output shortened), by turn range. Use it after search to see context, or to read the end of a session you are continuing (from_turn=-30 reads the last 30 turns). Every reply says which turns it covered and gives the exact call to continue.

session.description: Session id (or 8+ char prefix) from search or threads.

from_turn.description: First turn to read (default 1). Negative counts from the end: -30 = last 30 turns.

max_chars.description: Character budget for the reply (default 12000, max 40000).

from_char.description: Resume inside from_turn at this character, when a reply had to cut that turn (its continuation line gives it).

tools.name: threads
tools.description: List past sessions (threads), newest first, with one line each: id, harness, project, start → end, turn count, title, the opening ask and the last assistant words, plus parent/child links. Filter by project, harness and time window to see what a project's threads are doing, and by text= to list EVERY thread containing some words (exhaustive, not ranked) — use that to answer 'which threads touched X'. Subagent threads are hidden unless include_subagents=true.

since.description: Threads active at or after this ISO date/time.

until.description: Threads active at or before this ISO date/time.

text.description: Only threads whose transcript contains all of these words.

parent.description: List the child threads (subagents, forks) of this session id.

tools.name: grep
tools.description: Find every occurrence of an exact string inside ONE session, in reading order, including full tool output. Use it when you know the wording (an error, a path, a number) and need where or how often it appears. No match clears only that spelling in that session.

regex.description: Treat pattern as a regular expression.

instructions: Memory of the user's past AI coding sessions (Claude Code, Codex, Pi), every project, including sessions the harness deleted. Read-only. Use it whenever the user refers to earlier work, or when you continue a session.
